description: NESC atmospheric check-cases 1-16 (excluding 14 and 17) as reproduced by VITAL. Every value is taken from NASA/TM-2015-218675 Vols I-II, Initial_Conditions.xlsx, the DAVE-ML files or the reference CSVs, with citations; see docs/nesc/NESC_EXTRACT_*.md. The band is pre-registered (ADR-009) before any VITAL run.
band_rule: pass if VITAL(t) in [min_s ref_s(t) - delta, max_s ref_s(t) + delta] over sims s not excluded, delta = max(floor, rel_floor*max_t|ref|, k*(max_s-min_s)(t)), on the reference time base (linear interpolation of VITAL onto reference times)

common_f16.criterion_global: none (V1 p.10/PDF14); Appendix E eq.38 max % diff vs ensemble avg, first 8 s ignored, SIM 2 excluded (V2 pp.588-590/PDF592-594)
